cohort: Women with abnormally invasive placentation from 2003 through 2017 at a referral center in Paris
finding: Severe maternal morbidity is much more frequent in women with placenta percreta than with placenta accreta, despite multidisciplinary planning, management in a referral center, and better antenatal suspicion.
mod_finding: The rate of hysterectomy during cesareans was significantly higher in the percreta than the accreta group (52.9% [27/51] vs 20.9% [22/105], P < .01) as was the total hysterectomy rate (43/51 [84.3%] vs 23.8% [25/105], P < .01).
